attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses designated for clinical social workers offered by ASWB, NASW, CSWA or APA approved providers; other courses on diagnosing, assessing, treating or preventing mental/emotional disorders, developmental disabilities and substance abuse taught by qualified instructors; self-directed activities (teaching, publishing, presenting, field instruction, clinical staffing) max 10 h. Business, computer, financial, administrative or practice-development courses do not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First period prorated by issue date: 36/30/24/0 hours (issued before Jul 1 odd year / Jul 1 odd-Jan 31 even / Feb 1-Jun 30 even / Jul 1 even-Jan 31 odd); at least 6 hours ethics.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; enter CE in the DELPROS CE tracker and upload certificates only if selected for audit.
rules.notes: Licenses run Feb 1 to Jan 31 of odd-numbered years. 1 hour = 50 minutes. Max 10 hours self-directed activity.
